new.why: Google DeepMind published Genie 4 with steerable world generation, native audio and documented coherence limitations.
new.summary: Native multimodal world simulation generates interactive scenes, movement, dialogue and ambient sound together while responding to user steering in real time.
new.why_now: Google DeepMind’s October 27 Genie 4 preview adds native audio, real-time interaction and explicit object-permanence, spatial and long-session limitations.
new.practical_value: Evaluation teams can test latency, continuity, object permanence, text quality and audio alignment before using generated worlds for training or design.

evidence.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation

momentum.reason: No stable comparable measure has two dated numerical observations, so momentum remains unestablished for Genie 4.

updated.practical_value: Teams can design a bounded release and runtime gate that names quality thresholds, cost limits, intervention owners, approval steps and recovery tests.

evidence.title: Salesforce Expands Agent Fabric to Catch Failures and Control Costs
